verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a distributed legal-services firm offering fintech regulatory, corporate, IP, privacy and employment counsel, not a software platform. A sandbox test environment separate from production data is a category error for this kind of provider. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any software environment or API; the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
